segments.text: When using the welding head to cut metal sheets, have you ever encountered a situation where it cannot cut through?
segments.zh: 用焊接头切割金属板时，你有没有遇到过切不透的情况？

segments.text: Today, we're going to teach you step by step how to solve this issue.
segments.zh: 今天，我们就一步一步地教你如何解决这个问题。

segments.text: Possible cause. 1. Inadequate preparation before cutting.
segments.zh: 可能的原因 1：切割前准备不充分。

segments.text: First, remove the welding wire from the welding head and replace the welding tip with a cutting tip.
segments.zh: 首先，从焊接头上取下焊丝，把焊接头嘴换成切割头。

segments.text: Pull out the welding tip.
segments.zh: 拔出焊接头嘴。

segments.text: Then, install the cutting tip.
segments.zh: 然后，装上切割头。

segments.text: Note that the cutting tip has scale markings.
segments.zh: 注意，切割头上有刻度标记。

segments.text: Check the focus scale reference on the touch screen.
segments.zh: 查看触摸屏上的焦点刻度参考值。

segments.text: And adjust the cutting tip to match the focus scale reference value.
segments.zh: 并调整切割头，使之与焦点刻度参考值一致。

segments.text: Now, the installation is done.
segments.zh: 现在，安装完成了。

segments.text: After installation, power on the machine and check whether the welding head emits a clear, complete red spot.
segments.zh: 安装完成后，打开机器电源，检查焊接头是否发出清晰、完整的红点。

segments.text: If not, please calibrate the red spot position to avoid burning the nozzle during laser cutting.
segments.zh: 如果没有，请校准红点位置，以免激光切割时烧坏喷嘴。

segments.text: For shielding gas, choose compressed air, nitrogen, or argon.
segments.zh: 保护气可以选择压缩空气、氮气或氩气。

segments.text: Today, we take nitrogen as an example.
segments.zh: 今天，我们以氮气为例。

segments.text: Install a pressure regulator on the gas cylinder.
segments.zh: 在气瓶上安装减压器。

segments.text: Press and hold the grip sensing button and trigger to allow gas flow.
segments.zh: 按住握持感应按钮和扳机，让气体流出。

segments.text: Meanwhile, adjust the gas pressure to 800 kilopascals to 1,200 kilopascals.
segments.zh: 同时，把气压调到 800 千帕至 1,200 千帕。

segments.text: Here, we set it to 1,000 kilopascals.
segments.zh: 这里，我们把它设为 1,000 千帕。

segments.text: Hold down the grip sensing button and trigger, and adjust the pressure.
segments.zh: 按住握持感应按钮和扳机，调节压力。

segments.text: Place the workpiece stably on a metal base or other support.
segments.zh: 把工件稳稳地放在金属底座或其他支撑物上。

segments.text: Ensure that the cutting area is suspended without touching the support.
segments.zh: 确保切割区域悬空，不接触支撑物。

segments.text: Otherwise, the material melted during cutting may stick to the support.
segments.zh: 否则，切割时熔化的材料可能会粘在支撑物上。

segments.text: Also, remember to clean the cutting area with an alcohol wipe to remove grease and dust.
segments.zh: 另外，记得用酒精擦拭布清洁切割区域，去除油脂和灰尘。

segments.text: If you need to cut a curve, you can draw a guideline with a marker first.
segments.zh: 如果需要切割曲线，可以先用记号笔画一条参考线。

segments.text: If you make a mistake, you can erase and correct it with alcohol.
segments.zh: 如果画错了，可以用酒精擦掉再改。

segments.text: If you need a very precise cut, it is recommended to use the CNC cutter.
segments.zh: 如果你需要非常精确的切割，建议使用数控切割机。

segments.text: If you need to cut a straight line, press down the workpiece with metal plates or other tools,
segments.zh: 如果需要切割直线，用金属板或其他工具压住工件，

segments.text: which helps prevent the cut from deviating.
segments.zh: 这有助于防止切口跑偏。

segments.text: Then, clamp the workpiece sensing cable to the workpiece or a conductive object connected to it.
segments.zh: 然后，把工件感应线夹在工件上，或者夹在与工件相连的导电物体上。

segments.text: Otherwise, the welding head cannot emit laser beams.
segments.zh: 否则，焊接头无法发出激光束。

segments.text: On the touch screen, select Standard mode.
segments.zh: 在触摸屏上选择“标准模式”。

segments.text: Select Cut.
segments.zh: 选择“切割”。

segments.text: Select Stainless steel as the material and the material thickness.
segments.zh: 材料选择“不锈钢”，并选择材料厚度。

segments.text: Finally, tap Enable lasering and start cutting.
segments.zh: 最后，点击“启用激光”，开始切割。

segments.text: Now, I will demonstrate how to cut a straight line.
segments.zh: 现在，我来演示如何切割直线。

segments.text: When cutting, hold the welding head with the cutting tip contacting the workpiece at a 45 degree angle.
segments.zh: 切割时，握住焊接头，让切割头以 45 度角接触工件。

segments.text: Then, press and hold the grip sensing button and trigger and slowly pull the welding head backward.
segments.zh: 然后，按住握持感应按钮和扳机，慢慢向后拉焊接头。

segments.text: Slow down the backward movement.
segments.zh: 放慢向后移动的速度。

segments.text: Moving too fast can lead to incomplete cutting.
segments.zh: 移动太快会导致切不透。

segments.text: To avoid laser injury, ensure that no one stands in the laser reflection zone during cutting.
segments.zh: 为避免激光伤害，切割时确保没有人站在激光反射区内。

segments.text: Also, ensure that there are no flammable materials in the laser's travel path.
segments.zh: 另外，确保激光的行进路径上没有易燃物。

segments.text: After cutting, the workpiece and cutting tip remain hot for some time.
segments.zh: 切割后，工件和切割头在一段时间内仍然很烫。

segments.text: Do not touch the hot areas without protection.
segments.zh: 没有防护时不要触摸高温区域。

segments.text: Next, I will demonstrate how to cut a curve.
segments.zh: 接下来，我来演示如何切割曲线。

segments.text: You can draw guidelines with a marker before cutting or cut it directly.
segments.zh: 你可以在切割前用记号笔画参考线，也可以直接切割。

segments.text: After cutting, turn off Enable lasering on the touch screen to prevent accidental laser emission.
segments.zh: 切割完成后，在触摸屏上关闭“启用激光”，以防意外出光。

segments.text: Possible cause 3, Incorrect cutting parameter setting.
segments.zh: 可能的原因 3：切割参数设置不正确。

segments.text: On the touch screen, select Standard mode.
segments.zh: 在触摸屏上选择“标准模式”。

segments.text: Select Cut.
segments.zh: 选择“切割”。

segments.text: Then, check whether the selections of material and thickness are correct.
segments.zh: 然后，检查材料和厚度的选择是否正确。

segments.text: If all the settings are correct but the material still cannot be cut through,
segments.zh: 如果所有设置都正确，但材料仍然切不透，

segments.text: switch to Advanced mode.
segments.zh: 就切换到“高级模式”。

segments.text: Select Cut.
segments.zh: 选择“切割”。

segments.text: Now, I will demonstrate how to cut a curve.
segments.zh: 现在，我来演示如何切割曲线。

segments.text: Switch to Advanced mode.
segments.zh: 切换到“高级模式”。

segments.text: Select Cut.
segments.zh: 选择“切割”。

segments.text: Increase the laser power.
segments.zh: 提高激光功率。

segments.text: Then, test again to see whether it can cut through.
segments.zh: 然后再测试一下，看能不能切透。

segments.text: You can also turn on Professional to adjust more parameters.
segments.zh: 你也可以打开“专业”模式来调整更多参数。

segments.text: If your problems still can't be solved, please send us the four pieces of info above.
segments.zh: 如果你的问题仍然无法解决，请把以上四项信息发给我们。

segments.text: Screenshots of the studio file and the work log.
segments.zh: Studio 文件和工作日志的截图。

segments.text: A photo of the machine's SN code.
segments.zh: 机器 SN 码的照片。

segments.text: A video of a cured problem and steps you've already taken.
segments.zh: 一段问题发生过程的视频，以及你已经采取过的步骤。
